test_actor_critic_smoke: run a smoke test for the actor-critic RL training with a short episode length and small episode count
test_actor_critic_with_benchmark: test the actor-critic main function using the cbench-v1/crc32 benchmark with configurable seed and episode length
test_actor_critic_output_capture: test the actor-critic training loop by capturing stdout and asserting the final performance reward message
test_actor_critic_flags: test the actor-critic module by setting absl flags for seed, episode length, episodes, log interval, and benchmark
test_actor_critic_main_entry: test the actor-critic main entry point function with a controlled argv and captured output
